# Rogerson

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P19](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Sunday School teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)</sub>  
  _previously: Sunday-school teacher (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P19](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P29](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Rogerson is a middle-aged lady who teaches a Sunday-school class. She is described as a small beauty with hazel eyes and long brown curls.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P19](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0019), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Rogerson is described as being exceptionally mean and horrid in her behavior. Despite her unpleasant demeanor, she is also noted for her physical attractiveness.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)_

## Traits

- mean (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>

## History

Rogerson was a middle-aged lady who taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. She instructed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during Anne's first solitary visit to Sunday school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P3](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
